items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And I would tell Joe Zawinul, Wayne Shorter, Jaco [Pastorious] into their face that they're lying, man.

ctx.x: The Weather Report will tell you that, that they play the new jazz and if what they do is the synthesis of every thing that went on before.
No, well they're lying. They are a liar. And I would tell Joe Zawinul, Wayne Shorter, Jaco [Pastorious] into their face that they're lying, man.
They claim that they are the new musicians; that they're playing the new music of the '80's and the future--that they're the now people. All those people are in the past that--
